verdict.rationale: The evidence pack is almost entirely gaming/creator-focused (DLSS, Reflex, NVENC) with only one line noting RTX AI PCs 'maximize performance across Windows ML, Ollama, PyTorch, and other inference backends' — a thin nod to LLM inference support but without naming TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, or llama.cpp, and no mention of FP8/FP4 precision support for this specific GPU. missing for 10: explicit FP8/FP4 quantization documentation, named support for TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/llama.cpp, and any benchmark or hands-on inference throughput data for the 5070 Ti specifically.
